'''Rusty''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked with [[Tait Ransom]]. Around [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], he was on [[Omman Minor]] with Ransom when the latter was captured by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces. Rusty helped Ransom, [[Karl Mathieu Ancher]], [[Drake Paulsen]], and [[Nikaede Celso]] escape from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] captivity.
